description: Election Commission - W. M. S. Kumari was selected as the member of the Walapane P/S - M. G. M. S. Bandara was selected as the member of the Kotmale P/S - C. P. M. Uyangoda was selected as the member of the Nuwara Eliya P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of newly elected members to fill seats that became vacant due to party membership changes, which falls under electoral processes and related matters. The content focuses on election procedures, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
